summary_en: Nippon Felt acquired 450,000 shares (2.45% of outstanding shares) on September 16, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 at 1,016 yen per share for a total of 457.2 million yen. This represents the first block execution under the buyback authorization approved on June 26, 2026, which permits acquisitions of up to 1 million shares for a maximum of 750 million yen through January 15, 2027.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares by off-hours dealing transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 16, 2026, Nippon Felt executed an off-hours share acquisition through the ToSTNeT-3 trading system. The company purchased 450,000 shares at 1,016 yen per share, totaling 457.2 million yen. This acquisition represents 2.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

This transaction was the first execution under a buyback authorization approved by the board on June 26, 2026. Under that authorization, the company is permitted to acquire up to 1 million shares for a maximum total consideration of 750 million yen during the period from July 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027. Prior to this block acquisition on September 16, the company had cumulatively acquired 37,800 shares for 35.178 million yen under the same authorization. The acquisition price was set at the closing price (including final special quotation) on September 15, 2026.
